text:
Maria: heads up — telemetry is showing a weird spike in "granted" counts for scoped roles after yesterday's console deploy :thinking:
Aj: saw that too. numbers look doubled for some tenants. any correlation with the RBAC canary?
Sophie: pinging from infra — we rolled rbac-scopes v3 to 10% canary at 02:12 UTC. DeployBot: "rbac-scopes v3 canary started (10%)"
Kevin: possible duplicate counting? our metrics pipeline tags by `{role_id, tenant_id, evaluated_at}` — if evaluation ran twice we could double-count.
Prashant: also remember we changed the permissions evaluation cache key in v3: now includes `route_pattern` instead of `route_id`. that could cause cache misses -> more evals.
Lina: so increased evals would raise raw evals, but not "granted" rate unless something else changed. are we sure the grant condition logic didn't change?
Maria: I diffed the evaluation code — grant semantics unchanged. but there is a new fallback path that resolves wildcard scopes differently, could be less strict -> more grants.
Aj: can we reproduce locally? quick curl to evaluate endpoint with a known token + route to compare v2 vs v3 behavior.
Sophie: snippet i used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/permissions/evaluate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer dev-token"
  -d '{"tenant":"acme","principal":"svc-123","route":"/v1/generate","method":"POST"}'
```
Sophie: v2 returns `granted: false, reasons: ["scope-mismatch"]`, v3 returns `granted: true, reasons: ["inherited-scope (*)"]`
Kevin: that matches telemetry uptick — wildcard inheritance now matching `route_pattern` earlier than before.
Prashant: problem: telemetry UI aggregates by `scope_id` only. when inheritance kicks in the reason is `inherited` but we don't surface which binding matched. customers see more grants but cannot trace why.
Lina: UX ask: add an "explain" column in the permissions table showing the winning binding and whether it was direct/inherited/route-affinity.
Maria: agree. but backend API needs to return `winning_binding_id` and `explain_chain` to support that. currently we only return boolean + list of reason keys.
Aj: debate: should we extend `/v1/permissions/evaluate` or add a separate `/v1/permissions/explain`? cost/perf tradeoff: explain requires walking ancestry and hit DB more.
Sophie: we could make explain opt-in via query param `?explain=true` so normal evals stay cheap and telemetry can call explain asynchronously for a sample.
Prashant: for telemetry counts, sampling explain is fine. but the telemetry aggregator must de-dupe evals across rollout variants. we also need to tag metrics with `rbac_version` so we can split v2/v3.
Kevin: good point — add `rbac_version` label to prometheus metric `permissions_eval_total{result="granted"}`. that will show real deltas.
Lina: UX follow-up: can we show a compact breadcrumb like `role:team-read > binding:tenant-default > matched-by:route-wildcard` in the console row? designers will want a tooltip with full chain.
Maria: rollout plan to avoid noisy alerts:
- revert rbac-scopes v3 to 0% if granted_rate > baseline * 1.2 for any enterprise tenant
- enable `?explain=true` sampling at 0.5% on canary to collect reason samples
- emit `rbac_version` label on eval metrics
- patch telemetry UI to surface sample reason quick view
Aj: quick FYI — we already have a flag in infra to kill canary: `deployctl abort canary rbac-scopes`.
Sophie: will add a short migration note in release channel: "v3 changes cache key semantics and wildcard matching; enable explain sampling for diagnostics." DeployBot: "rbac-scopes v3 canary scaled to 10% (unchanged)"
Prashant: one more sticky edge: impersonation tokens. if `principal` is an impersonation, the explain chain must show original principal and impersonator. otherwise audits are misleading.
Kevin: agree — add `impersonation_chain` to explain payload.
Lina: ui concern: we must avoid exposing internal ids to tenants. map `binding_id` -> friendly name in UI and redact raw DB ids in exported CSVs unless user is enterprise-admin.
Maria: +1. also add telemetry event `permission_explain_sampled` with hashed binding fingerprint (not raw id) to allow aggregation without leaking PII.
Aj: action items:
- Sophie: add `?explain=true` opt-in and `impersonation_chain` in API (PR)
- Prashant: tag eval metrics with `rbac_version` and ensure telemetry sampling de-duplicates (PR)
- Lina: mockups for explain breadcrumb + tooltip (Figma link to come)
- Kevin: update alerting rule to compare v2/v3 granted_rate and auto-abort canary (runbook)
Maria: i'll coordinate the canary hold and notify affected tenants. thanks all.
DeployBot: "rbac-scopes v3 canary (10%) — note: explain sampling enabled (0.5%)"
